verdict.rationale: Docs show the core loop: segments for audience selection (docs-11), broadcasts queued to defined recipients at a specified time (docs-13), UI-based broadcast setup with trigger API (docs-4), and Design Studio/drag-and-drop editor for composing messages (docs-16, docs-17). This covers compose, pick audience, and send/schedule as table-stakes. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow and explicit UI screenshots/docs of a scheduling calendar interface (only inferred from 'time you specify').
